title: R2007 independent runtime metadata, CRC-stage, and de-interleave cross-check
mode: focused existing-sample cross-check, test-only byte-transform/CRC diagnostics, and source review
scope: Independently cross-check existing AC1021 data-page and system-page map records, including the file-header CRC seed
Compare libdxfrw's (255,251) and (255,239) message extraction with separate source-derived de-interleave references
Recompute only the ODA-defined data/system CRC input spans on existing samples and compare against stored fields
Reassess LibreDWG, dwg-rs, and ACadSharp as possible page-CRC evidence sources
Update the active plan's CRC evidence boundary and next independent-witness gate

method.kind: Run installed LibreDWG on existing tablet and colorwh drawings; inspect R2007 decoder/checksum source in LibreDWG and ACadSharp; use manual-only test diagnostics with separate source-derived (255,251)/(255,239) de-interleave and bitwise ODA CRC calculations

/Users/dli/doc/dwg/dwgreader21_230.dwg: system-page descriptor extraction probe did not resolve; NOT_RUN/NOT_COMPARABLE
method.limitations: LibreDWG's current source extracts systematic RS message bytes but comments out its RS correction call and reports stored page CRC metadata without independently recomputing the examined R2007 page CRCs. Its successful parses are not CRC/FEC passes. ACadSharp's reviewed checksum calculator implements a 32-bit modulo-65521 sum and the reviewed section base handles version flags/sentinels; no AC1021 page-CRC call path was established from those sources. Local source-rule de-interleave code and bitwise CRC code are separate test calculations, not third-party runtimes. Matching message bytes do not validate parity symbols; matching a separately coded CRC calculation to a stored value has not occurred. The LibreDWG runs also emit nonfatal section/preview diagnostics. The dwgreader21_230 probe did not independently extract a page descriptor and is not a negative parser result.

sources.revision: Mutable master source reviewed 2026-10-18; decode_rs around lines 3154-3218; read_data_page around lines 3421-3505
sources.observed: decode_rs gathers each interleaved data symbol by stepping the encoded input by block_count and copies data_size symbols per block; its RS correction call is commented out with a TODO. read_data_page uses 0xFB (251) data symbols for R2007 data-page payload. Page-map parsing logs the stored checksum and crc64 values; the examined path does not recompute the section data-page CRC.

The repository labels the implementation pre-alpha and its Reed-Solomon read-side fallback wiring pending, so this is source-level triangulation, not a qualified runtime or CRC oracle.

sources.revision: Mutable master support table and selected R21/checksum/section sources reviewed 2026-10-18; not built or run
sources.observed: The project advertises AC1021 DWG reading and has an R21-specific LZ decompressor. The reviewed DwgCheckSumCalculator uses a 32-bit sum with modulo-65521 reduction; the reviewed CRC utility and DwgSectionIO did not establish a call path that recomputes AC1021 page CRCs over the ODA §5.3/§5.4 spans. ACadSharp remains a possible structural/semantic differential, not a CRC oracle on this evidence.

sources.revision: Working-tree manual-only test selectors and independent scratch Python calculation run 2026-10-18
sources.observed: Tablet data page AcDb:Header 0x1c: physical offset 0x67680, extent 0x400, encoding 4, cSize 779, uSize 857, crc_seed 0, stored checksum 0x8deb465b and stored CRC 0xfe7642845db5fda9. Source-derived (255,251) de-interleave matches production bytes (0 differences); mirrored CRC computes 0x6b1cdfbc3715d1fc, while logical checksum matches. Tablet system page 0x21: physical offset 0x480, encoded extent 0x4fb, cSize 0xc2, uSize 0x1f0, correction factor 5, decoded seed 0; source-derived (255,239) de-interleave matches production bytes. Compressed and uncompressed CRCs compute 0x4de401459759be97 and 0x6ca187aa62a39be3, versus stored 0x10100fea5403d32f and 0x270e0216019558e1. Colorwh system page 0x49: physical offset 0x1b2a60, encoded extent 0xaf5, cSize 0x193, uSize 0x480, correction factor 6, encoded seed 0x76cb0c4696515083/decoded seed 0; compressed and uncompressed CRCs compute 0xfb92c8df5978a155 and 0xdce0c350db24f2d5, versus stored 0x578c72dccda3f31c and 0x186ea5e9d33e7153. Both test-local system-page de-interleave references match production payload bytes and parseSysPage succeeds despite CRC warnings. LibreDWG independently reports the colorwh page metadata and stored values. A separately written Python bitwise CRC calculation reproduces the compressed-span values for the tablet data/system pages and colorwh system page; no external CRC oracle has matched a stored page CRC.
